swamping.applies_to: any live aircraft actually sitting on sea surface
swamping.actual_loss_consumer: operations::crash_aircraft once; real body/cleanup, aircraft loss ledger and own Ditched

rts_policy.tolerance_meaning: Floating point equality only; not a wind-safe heading/speed allowance or pickup radius
rts_policy.card_scope: Explicit matching unarmed author complete platform/Flight card; declared Low level only; no real Annex capability alias
rts_policy.movement_mapping: Normal shared Movement-end barrier, not an invented elapsed run-up/descent duration
rts_policy.resting_motion: Explicit author hold position with engines stopped; no water taxi/current/drift model
rts_policy.takeoff_baseline: Reset Flight distance clock to actual completion now/position without adding fuel
rts_policy.landing_fuel: Normal shared fuel_step settles actual last airborne interval before water mode
rts_policy.swamp_cadence: One scoped natural trial on normal completed180s Tac boundary, persisted before common loss; no draw for moored/zero-risk; dead body cannot reroll
rts_policy.partial_Tac_exposure: Unresolved beyond explicit boundary-current-water RTS mapping; source candidates stay waterborne for the full firstTac
rts_policy.initial_mooring_scope: Explicit author fixed buoy/pier at same actual body position; no mooring/unmooring/winch procedure or moving tender geometry inferred
rts_policy.shelter_scope: Only explicit scenario location assigned at initial actual water point; no invented geographic extent; open water has no reduction
